I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: the 2027 renewal at Thornbury Cloth Co. (Bittern) is 163 seats."

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count isn't a money figure, so it's fine to have in that channel. The workspace's knowledge base (gbrain) is set up to save channel messages automatically, so her note should be on record there.
